sanskrit_verse:
ekoddiṣṭaं देवहीनं एकार्घ्यैकपवित्रकम् ।
आवाहनाग्नौकरणरहितं हि अपसव्यवत् ॥१.२५१॥
transliteration: ekoddiṣṭaṃ devahīnaṃ ekārghyaikapavitrakam / āvāhanāgnaukaraṇarahitaṃ hi apasavyavat // YajñS_1.251
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is dedicated to one deity alone, devoid of other deities, offered with a single oblation and sanctified by one sacred thread, without invocation or fire ritual, is conducted in reverse order.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in singular consecration, not multiplicity
Causation arises through focused intent rather than external formality
Capacity-based responsibility lies in alignment with divine unity
Restoration logic operates through re-centering on original purpose
Consciousness alignment occurs when action reflects undivided devotion
executable_legal_axioms: IF dedication is made to more than one entity THEN validity is null due to divided authority
IF invocation or fire ritual is performed without unified intent THEN act is reversed in consequence
IF offering lacks single-pointed focus THEN restoration requires re-consecration under unified principle
IF agent performs ritual without capacity for integration THEN realign through completion process
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving spiritual or ceremonial disputes, the court must assess whether the act was performed with singular consecration. Multiplicity in invocation invalidates the act at its root, requiring restoration via conscious realignment rather than procedural correction.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that efficacy stems from internal unity, not external performance. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows deviation occurred through lack of centered invocation. Responsibility is proportional to clarity of intent; thus corrective action aligns consciousness back to source-integrity without punitive consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Re-perform ceremony with singular consecration under witness of qualified authority
Invoke completion process where prior omission is consciously acknowledged and rectified
Restore integrity through purification of intent before repetition of rite
Assume responsibility by reaffirming alignment with foundational dharma of unity
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law flows directly from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma is restored through consciousness realignment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the ultimate adjudicator.
